title: Accessibility
description: How %SITE% tries to be usable by everyone, and where to report a barrier.

blocks.title: No Lagrix token
blocks.text: Lagrix has no token and no coin of its own: the network's money is USDC. Nothing is issued, sold or given away under the Lagrix name. Any offer to buy a token called LGX or Lagrix does not come from us.
We want everyone to be able to read %SITE%, with any device and any way of using it.

items: Pages are rendered on the server and readable without JavaScript.
Light and dark themes; text scales with the browser settings.
Buttons and dialogs work from the keyboard; pictures carry text descriptions.
Motion follows the «reduce motion» setting of your system.

blocks.text: Found a barrier? Write on Telegram [@roma_armstrong](https://t.me/roma_armstrong) — tell us the page and what got in the way. Back to [%SITE%](/en).
